name: Independent Set Disguise
description: Rephrases the exact cover requirement ("collectively utilize all k") as a pairwise exclusion requirement ("no two configurations share any parameter"). Since the target size is exactly k and the domain size is k, the two are mathematically identical. This prevents models from trivially grouping configurations by one parameter (which makes backtracking fast) and discourages Exact Cover translations (DLX), instead baiting them into writing generic Clique/Independent Set algorithms which will TLE.
